name: InputOTP
description: One-time code input for verification and two-factor sign in. One real input holds the code and drawn cells show it, so paste, autofill from SMS and screen readers all work.

label.description: Visible label, such as Verification code. Names the group.

description.description: Help text shown under the cells.

errorMessage.description: Shown when the code is invalid.

length.description: Number of characters in the code.

type.description: Characters accepted. Numeric also opens the numeric keypad on phones.

onChange.description: Called with the code on every edit.

onComplete.description: Called once when every cell is filled.

separatorAt.description: Draws a separator after these cell counts, for example [3] groups a 6 digit code as 3 + 3.

mask.description: Shows dots instead of the characters.

isDisabled.description: Prevents editing and dims the cells.

isInvalid.description: Marks the code as wrong and shows errorMessage.

keyboard: Type to fill and move forward
Left and Right Arrow move between cells
requirements: The group is named by its label
One real input carries the value, so autofill and paste work
autocomplete=one-time-code lets phones offer the SMS code
The current cell is announced as digit N of the total
The error is linked with aria-describedby and the input exposes aria-invalid
screenReader: On focus: the label, then edit text, then the description
Moving between cells announces the position, such as Digit 2 of 6
Invalid: announced as invalid, and the error message is read
Masked codes are announced as a protected field and the characters are never read aloud

use_when: Verifying an SMS, email or authenticator code
avoid_when: Free-form or variable-length text: use TextField
anti_patterns: Splitting the code into separate inputs, which breaks paste and autofill
Clearing the code silently on error: say what went wrong
